title: Screening fructosamine-3-kinase (FN3K) inhibitors, a deglycating enzyme of oncogenic Nrf2: Human FN3K homology modelling, docking and molecular dynamics simulations.
authors: Beeraka, Narasimha M; Zhang, Jin; Mandal, Subhankar; Vikram P R, Hemanth; Liu, Junqi; B M, Namitha; Zhao, Di; Vishwanath, Prashanth; B M, Gurupadayya; Fan, Ruitai
one_liner_zh: 该文研究FN3K激酶抑制剂筛选，涉及同源建模、对接和MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Fructosamine-3-kinase (FN3K) is involved in the deglycation of Nrf2, a significant regulator of oxidative stress in cancer cells. However, the intricate functional aspects of FN3K and Nrf2 in breast cancers have not been explored vividly. The objectives of this study are to design the human FN3K protein using homology modeling followed by the screening of several anticancer molecules and examining their efficacy to modulate FN3K activity, Nrf2-mediated antioxidant signalling. Methods pertinent to homology modeling, virtual screening, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, assessment of ADME properties, cytotoxicity assays for anticancer molecules of natural/synthetic origin in breast cancer cells (BT-474, T-47D), and Western blotting were used in this study. The screened anticancer molecules including kinase inhibitors of natural and synthetic origin interacted with the 3-dimensional structure of the catalytic domain in human FN3K protein designed through homology modeling by significant CDOCKER interaction energies. Subsequently, gefitinib, sorafenib, neratinib, tamoxifen citrate, and cyclosporine A enhanced the expression of FN3K in BT-474 cell lines with simultaneous alteration in Nrf2-driven antioxidant signalling. Oxaliplatin significantly downregulated FN3K expression and modulated Nrf2-driven antioxidant signalling when compared to cisplatin and other anticancer drugs. Hence, the study concluded the potential implications of existing anticancer drugs to modulate FN3K activity in breast cancers.
abstract_zh: 果糖胺-3-激酶（FN3K）参与Nrf2的去糖化作用，Nrf2是癌细胞中氧化应激的重要调节因子。然而，FN3K和Nrf2在乳腺癌中的复杂功能方面尚未得到充分探索。本研究旨在通过同源建模设计人FN3K蛋白，随后筛选多种抗癌分子，并检验其调节FN3K活性及Nrf2介导的抗氧化信号传导的功效。本研究采用了同源建模、虚拟筛选、分子对接、分子动力学模拟、ADME性质评估、针对天然/合成来源抗癌分子在乳腺癌细胞（BT-474、T-47D）中的细胞毒性测定以及Western blotting等方法。筛选出的抗癌分子，包括天然和合成来源的激酶抑制剂，通过显著的CDOCKER相互作用能量，与通过同源建模设计的人FN3K蛋白催化结构域的三维结构发生相互作用。随后，吉非替尼、索拉非尼、来那替尼、他莫昔芬柠檬酸盐和环孢素A在BT-474细胞系中增强了FN3K的表达，同时改变了Nrf2驱动的抗氧化信号传导。与顺铂和其他抗癌药物相比，奥沙利铂显著下调了FN3K表达，并调节了Nrf2驱动的抗氧化信号传导。因此，本研究得出结论，现有抗癌药物在乳腺癌中具有调节FN3K活性的潜在应用价值。
